description: A window mixer for a polyphonic input of up to 16 channels, stepping to the next channel on every trigger, with a slew of up to 5 seconds

params.text: Sets the slew applied between the old and the new channel value, up to 5 seconds
Attenuates and inverts the slew CV input
Picks how the next channel is chosen: forwards, forwards by 2, backwards, backwards by 2, ping-pong or random
Sets what the output carries: the selected channel alone, one channel per input starting at the selected one and wrapping round, or the selected value on all 16 channels
Steps the window on to the next channel
Returns the window to the start channel and cuts short any slew in progress
Reverses the direction of travel in ping-pong mode
Sets how many channels the window steps between, counted from the start channel; a count above the number of inputs makes no difference
Sets the channel the window steps from, and the one a reset returns to; a group running past the last channel wraps around to channel 1

inputs.text: The polyphonic input whose channels the window steps between; a channel with a signal lights green and the selected one lights brightly
A trigger steps the window on to the next channel
A trigger returns the window to the start channel and cuts short any slew in progress
Modulates the slew time, through its attenuvertor
Modulates the advance mode, a mode per volt added to the mode knob
Modulates how many channels the window steps between

outputs.text: 0.5V per channel for the selected channel, so channel 3 gives 1.5V and channel 16 gives 8V
The selected channel's value, scaled by the output attenuvertor

notes: patch a polyphonic signal into the signals input and a trigger into the trigger input; the window moves only on a trigger or a press of the button
menu: Mode knob horizontal: draws the advance mode control sideways
